**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always
frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Which package
does this affect — one of the existing seven, or something new?

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features
you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or examples about the feature request here.

<!--
Before submitting: a quick check of the RFC index's Status column and each RFC's own rejections,
plus the archived development-docs/_archives/ROADMAP.md's "Out of scope" and "Decided and
rejected" sections, can save you writing up something that's already been
considered — but don't let that stop you from posting if you're not sure.

Scope guide: this template is for focused, mostly-additive requests. If the
idea changes an XRD's public schema, adds a package, or commits the platform
to a new tool, use the "RFC — feature / design proposal" template instead —
it carries the design and compatibility sections that review will ask for
anyway. For recording a decision of lasting consequence, use the ADR template.
-->
